g.title: seq
g.text: 09a External audit by COA: from submission of accounts to the annual reports

a.text: 1. Accounting unit to COA audit team:
Accounts: paid vouchers with the daily reports
of payments, journal entries, reports. Year-
end statements by 14 February
2. COA audit team: Audit: financial (are the
statements fairly presented), compliance (were
the rules followed), performance (were results
achieved with economy)
3. COA audit team to Head of agency: Audit
Observation Memorandum on each finding
4. Head of agency to COA audit team: Comments,
explanations, documents
5. COA audit team to Head of agency: Notice of
Suspension. The amount is suspended until the
requirement is met
6. COA audit team to Head of agency: Notice of
Disallowance, naming the persons liable
7. COA audit team to Head of agency: Notice of
Charge, naming the persons liable
8. Head of agency to COA audit team:
Requirement met, or amount returned
10. Head of agency to COA directors: Appeal

a.xlink:title: end of: Finding on a transaction: a requirement is missing
end of: Finding on a transaction: illegal, irregular, unnecessary, excessive or extravagant expense
end of: Finding on revenue: under-assessment or under-collection

a.text: 14. COA audit team to Head of agency: When a
decision is final: Notice of Finality of
Decision. The agency records a receivable from
the persons liable. Then COA Order of
Execution (for example, withholding of pay)
9. COA audit team to Head of agency: Notice of
Settlement
11. COA directors to Head of agency: Decision
12. Head of agency to COA Commission Proper:
Petition for review
13. COA Commission Proper to Head of agency:
Decision of the Commission Proper
15. COA audit team to Head of agency: Each
quarter: Statement of Audit Suspensions,
Disallowances and Charges
16. COA audit team to Head of agency: Draft
findings discussed. Then the audit report of
the agency: opinion on the statements,
observations and recommendations, status of
earlier recommendations
17. Head of agency to COA audit team: Action
plan on the recommendations
18. COA audit team to President: COA annual
report on the financial condition and
operation of the government, by 30 September
